scenario.title: Browser runtime, personas and sign-in recovery
situations: Browser on an unconnected test host
Resettable machine must retain live logins
scenario.current: Research trace; requirements and source paths need live proof.
questions: Live identity persistence and individual site probes were not exercised; current docs/CLI contract, not a sign-in guarantee.

lessons.title: Prepare only the browser substrate needed
lessons.when: Before the first local Browser case or headed sign-in
lessons.need: Use the packaged browser runtime; Linux setup checks system libraries and names missing privilege/dependency recovery. A browser daemon belongs to its project/identity profile; local captures need no Test Machine lease.
lessons.surface: Public QA lines 215–226 and Machine QA README local-capture section.
lessons.gap: The row 13 pointer should distinguish local runtime repair from host provisioning and from account sign-in.

lessons.title: Declare personas before signing in
lessons.when: Test needs authenticated behavior or more than one account
lessons.need: A browser identity is a persona profile across declared sites. Declare origins and signed-in probes in browser-control; default exists. Cases choose browser_identity; missions can name several. API/CLI credentials remain separate capability secrets.
lessons.surface: Browser scenario method configuration → browser-identities reference.
lessons.gap: Feature teaching exists in depth; add an entry from authenticated test authoring rather than teaching every persona at startup.
recipes: yoke projects capability-settings get --project P --cap-type browser-control --json

lessons.title: Verify, request the exact human action, then resume
lessons.when: A declared site is signed out or an exploratory mission hits auth
lessons.need: Verify first; authorize opens only expired sites. Human supplies personal credentials; unreachable probes need technical repair. Sign-in pauses automated browsers on that machine until windows close. Disconnected test hosts receive nonsecret declarations; live identity store survives reset.
lessons.surface: Browser identities reference and authorize help; Pack per-OS sign-in procedure.
lessons.gap: Verified pointer defect: Pack browser-identities names docs/public/reference/... which external projects do not receive there. Use the installed .yoke/docs home. Per-OS links to Yoke-private test-account policy also need a portable audience boundary.
recipes: yoke projects capability-settings get --project P --cap-type browser-control --json
